// Independent local complementations, grouped by neighbourhood claims.
MATCH (center:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})
WHERE center.phase = 0.5 OR center.phase = 1.5

OPTIONAL MATCH (center)-[w:Wire]-(nbr:Node)
WITH center, collect(DISTINCT nbr) AS neighbors, collect(w) AS wires
WHERE ALL(x IN neighbors WHERE x.t = 1)
  AND ALL(w IN wires WHERE w.t = 2)

WITH collect({center: center, neighbors: neighbors,
              rank: id(center), claim: [center] + neighbors}) AS candidates
UNWIND candidates AS candidate
UNWIND candidate.claim AS v
WITH v, collect(candidate) AS claimants, min(candidate.rank) AS owner
UNWIND claimants AS candidate
WITH candidate.center AS center, candidate.neighbors AS neighbors,
     sum(CASE WHEN candidate.rank = owner THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS conflicts
WHERE conflicts = 0
WITH center, neighbors

// Enumerate neighbor pairs; sentinel -1 keeps the row alive when there are
// fewer than two neighbors (UNWIND of an empty list would drop the row and
// the center would never be deleted).
UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(neighbors) >= 2 THEN range(0, size(neighbors) - 2) ELSE [-1] END) AS i
UNWIND (CASE WHEN i >= 0 THEN range(i + 1, size(neighbors) - 1) ELSE [-1] END) AS j
WITH center, neighbors,
     CASE WHEN i >= 0 THEN neighbors[i] END AS n1,
     CASE WHEN j >= 0 THEN neighbors[j] END AS n2

// Toggle: create the Hadamard edge if missing, otherwise collect it for deletion.
OPTIONAL MATCH (n1)-[e:Wire {t: 2}]-(n2)
FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN n1 IS NOT NULL AND e IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
  CREATE (n1)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: center.graph_id}]->(n2)
)

WITH center, neighbors, collect(e) AS toggled_off
FOREACH (e IN toggled_off | DELETE e)

FOREACH (n IN neighbors |
  SET n.phase = ((coalesce(n.phase, 0) - center.phase) % 2 + 2) % 2
)

DETACH DELETE center

RETURN count(*) AS patterns_processed
